sentences.en: It was the teacher's narrative that bored me to death.
sentences.zh: 是老师的讲述让我感到厌烦至极。

sentences.en: It was his lengthy narrative that bored me to death.
sentences.zh: 是他冗长的叙述让我感到厌烦至极。

sentences.en: Even his everyday speech was an off-the-cuff, tangential, disjointed narrative.
sentences.zh: 即使他日常的话语也像是即兴发挥、离题且杂乱无章的故事。
